caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur placed centrally against a plain, light beige or off-white background. The spur is mostly rendered in shades of dark brown and gray, with metallic detailing to show its hard, reflective surface. The object consists of a curved band designed to fit around a boot heel, with a prominent rowel (the rotating wheel with sharp points) on one side. The rowel is circular with multiple pointed spokes radiating out, and it is attached to the main body by a small round fastener. The band of the spur features a lighter-colored inlay or decorative strip along its center, adding contrast to the otherwise dark surface. There are hinges and clasps visible, with two rounded joints forming a section that could rotate or flex. At the end of the spur band, there is a small hooked piece extending downward. The composition is minimal, with the object isolated against the blank background and centered, leaving significant negative space around it. A small, neat signature appears in red in the lower right corner beneath the spur.
title: Spur
